The First event at [[Castle Ikaris]]. The actual event of the dance/ gala will be on October 11th, but the town will be celebrating the total eclipse for 2 days beforehand and on the evening of the ball. 
The celebration in Archemos cannot be understated as anything but extravagant. There are lanterns lit through the night, there are lots of merchants selling goods in the streets and exotic sweets and dishes as people gather for the festivities and tournament. 

EVENT:
- The arrivals: The event begins at 2pm, under the black sky of the total eclipse. Some people have arrived early to help set up/ because they are special: King [[Adrithyr]], Queen [[Characters/People/Annabelle|Annabelle]], Prince [[Lukas]], Lord Damion Syrell, Lady Elena Syrell, Lord Tlaloc of Redsong, Lord Clover. 
- The [[Castle Ikaris]] is beautiful, see that note for more info. 
- When arriving, one of the servants greets them and leads them to their suite, there are 10 rooms off of  common area with a fireplace and lounge area. There are private baths in the castle. The rooms are open to the players for the duration of the events. With the players in their suite is [[Maple]], [[Alabaster]], and [[Evan]]. Brakk has a servants room nearby, and he along with 3 other knights of the Warrior's Way have been volunteered as guards to the group. 2 will stay stationed outside the rooms at all times during the night.

WEAPONS AND ARMOR ARE NOT PERMITTED!

There is a full orchestra playing off to the side of the massive ballroom, attached is a large archway leading to where the banquet will be held afterwards.

As the party enters the room they see Clover awaiting them, bowing once again in his fancy white suit and saying he's glad to see them here, its a wonderful event they deserve to be a part of. (Alabaster and Maple are with them). Clover asks if Mishann has gotten comfortable with her wings, and if she would like to do a traditional dance of his people a bit later (no pressure he's very nervous too as he's never done it for a crowd before, all she has to do is follow his lead).

- Shit that does happen (in order)
	- Alabaster asks Melantha to dance
	- As the party begins to enter the social situations
	- Evan informs someone from the party that there is a rumor Calix is planning an alliance with Ivar, apparently he wants to use Ivar to get rid of Adrithyr, and sit his son on the throne of Estor. 
	- The lights dim as the crystal chandeliers begin to glow faintly, you see a dancer across the ceiling appearing to float and spin across the air itself, they wear a mask that appears to change and flow as they move, a one person show depicting a story of tragic star crossed love, ending in death and despair. It is a sight to behold, and the movements and expertise of the acrobat impress the nobles and warriors to great effect.
	- People begin to partner up and dance, Annabelle gets up and tries to get Adrithyr to dance, he refuses and keeps drinking wine.
	- As the night goes on and people dance, the eclipse takes the sky. The great skylight at the ceiling shows the strange and magical darkness of it, the sun completely eclipsed behind the 6 moons of Terra-Nova. A spatial event that only happens once every thousand years. It is breathtaking. As the moons align perfectly, for just a moment, Reister. You feel suddenly heavier, thicker, more sturdy. You hear a soft ticking of a clock in your heart, and you look down as your body morphs, going from rocks and stones, to almost liquid and flowing metal like that of Kronos. You are now a Metal Genasi (see Statblock google doc). Reister has a symbol of an hourglass engraved on his forehead. 
	- ECLIPSE: During the eclipse the only light in the entire ballroom is from the moons, and it is faint. The entire sky is dark but darker than usual, dark like magical darkness. As the darkness takes hold you can see every single star in the sky, a once in a lifetime event and the sky is breathtaking. At the apex of the eclipse, everyone roll a D20 as a female voice enters your mind and whispers a single word: Evens hear "Love", Odds hear "Madness"
	- [[Yara Vision]] As everyone enjoys the beautiful moment, you see a pair of golden lights erupt from the eyes of someone, and Yara begins to speak in what seems like a thousand voices at once (avatar state voice).
	- The night continues until we transition into the banquet, which is frankly boring. The party is sat at a table by themselves and can have a delicious meal cooked by master chefs from the Castle.
	- PERCEPTION CHECK: You see Lukas and Allison sneaking off from a side door and leaving the dance, giggling and holding hands
	- The band starts playing feast and party music, and things get rowdy as Bjorn starts the traditional Winterlandian drinking game: Drink until you drop
	- Bjorn challenges on of the party to a dance battle (contested performance checks)
	- The tourney drawing commences, King Adrithyr draws from a woven blue ceremonial basket:
		- There are 8 slots, each slot be taken by the names drawn from left to right
		- First name drawn is Augustus, then Lukas
		- Second is Bjorn and Mervin
		- Third is Melantha, and Alabaster
		- Fourth and final is Diego and Dante

- Shit that might happen (d6)
	- 1: Lady Jessica walks over to the party with Calix and introduces herself, as if they don't know each other. Calix has heard of them, Jessica thinks she remembers Ivys from somewhere but she can't remember where from. She keeps persisting that she knows him from somewhere... (Calix looks unhappy with that)
	- 2: Bjorn gets super drunk, and a bunch of his friends and guards dare him to arm wrestle the talking rocks (Reister)
	- 3: Tlaloc introduces himself to Ivys, and says that as the White Wizard he is always welcome at Redsong, and if he wanted to teach a class at the academy or do some talks to some of the underprivileged youths Tlaloc would love to arrange it. He asks for Ivys' help to do 
	- 4: Lukas and Elena are talking, Lukas looks really nervous and shy as Elena laughs at him, she looks like she wants him to ask her to dance. As Lukas is about to speak Argus (Calix's son) walks up and takes Elena's hand, asking her to dance, she reluctantly agrees and walks away as Lukas turns away frustrated.
	- 5: Soraya sneaks up behind Antigone, and lightly taps them on the shoulder, she smiles toothily and sexily, "You see my fangs darling... let me see yours. Sing us a song famous Antigone" She asks them to sing a song/ tell a tale.
	- 6: Lord Torin bravely approaches Melantha, and asks her to dance despite his 4 foot stature. He says in his culture the tallest dwarf women are the most beautiful and coveted prize in the mountain, and she is the tallest woman he has ever seen.
